description: We are a team of passionate students from JNNCE ,Shivamogga working on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Our goal is to build a farmer-friendly dashboard using NASA satellite data (rainfall, soil moisture) to give simple "plant now / wait" advice for local crops. We're looking for teammates skilled in web development, data analysis, UI/UX design, and presentation/communication. If you care about agriculture, climate, and real-world impact, join us!
summary:
FarmShift AI – Project Summary
FarmShift AI is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform developed to help farmers make informed crop selection decisions based on soil conditions and weather patterns.
The system collects farmer information and detects their geographical location using GPS. It retrieves weather data, including temperature, humidity, and rainfall, through NASA APIs. Farmers can manually enter soil nutrient values (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, and pH) or upload a Soil Health Card. Using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), the system extracts relevant soil information from uploaded reports.
The collected soil and weather data are processed and passed to a Machine Learning model, which predicts and recommends suitable crops based on the available conditions.
Technologies Used: Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Machine Learning, NASA APIs, and Tesseract OCR.
Objective: To support farmers with data-driven crop recommendations, improve agricultural decision-making, and encourage smarter and more sustainable farming practices.
details: Project Details – FarmShift AI FarmShift AI is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform designed to help farmers select suitable crops based on soil conditions and local weather patterns. The system collects farmer information and detects their geographical location using GPS. It retrieves temperature, humidity, and rainfall data through NASA APIs. Farmers can manually enter soil nutrient values (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, and pH) or upload a Soil Health Card. Using Tesseract OCR, the system extracts soil information from uploaded documents. The collected soil and weather data are processed and passed to a Machine Learning model, which predicts and recommends suitable crops. Benefits and Intended Impact: FarmShift AI aims to reduce guesswork in crop selection, support informed agricultural decisions, improve resource utilization, and help farmers choose crops that are better suited to their local environmental conditions. Technologies Used: Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Machine Learning, NASA APIs, Tesseract OCR, and GitHub. Creativity and Innovation: The project combines NASA-based weather information, GPS-based location detection, soil health card scanning, OCR, and Machine Learning in a single platform. Instead of depending entirely on manual data entry, farmers can upload their soil reports to simplify the process. Factors Considered: Soil nutrients, soil pH, temperature, humidity, rainfall, geographical location, data accuracy, ease of use, and accessibility for farmers. Our goal is to make agriculture smarter, more accessible, and data-driven through technology.
